has_target.docs:
If a target is detected with either still or in movement **has_target** will be set true for the duration of the **presence_time_window** setting. May contain any options from [Binary Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/binary_sensor#config-binary_sensor).

*See also: [LD2420 24GHz mmWave Radar Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2420#configuration-variables)*

apply_config.docs:
Saves both manual config tuning or the auto calibrate still and move threshold config settings. May contain any options from [Button](https://esphome.io/components/button#config-button).

*See also: [LD2420 24GHz mmWave Radar Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2420#configuration-variables)*

factory_reset.docs:
Restores a base set of LD2420 configuration values. May contain any options from [Button](https://esphome.io/components/button#config-button).

*See also: [LD2420 24GHz mmWave Radar Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2420#configuration-variables)*

restart_module.docs:
Reboots the LD2420 modules. May contain any options from [Button](https://esphome.io/components/button#config-button).

*See also: [LD2420 24GHz mmWave Radar Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2420#configuration-variables)*

revert_config.docs:
Undoes in-progress edits prior to their application via the `apply_config` button. May contain any options from [Button](https://esphome.io/components/button#config-button).

*See also: [LD2420 24GHz mmWave Radar Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2420#configuration-variables)*

gate_move_sensitivity.docs:
Gate move threshold calibration sensitivity factor. Defaults to 0.5 with a range of 0-1, 0 = high and 1 = low. May contain any options from [Number](https://esphome.io/components/number#config-number).

*See also: [LD2420 24GHz mmWave Radar Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2420#configuration-variables)*

gate_select.docs:
Selection of gate value to edit (gate # from 0 to 15). Gate thresholds are edited by selecting the gate number and then adjusting the move and still thresholds. **Note that when this variable is defined, the component will run in compact UI mode and the following two configuration variables are then required:** May contain any options from [Number](https://esphome.io/components/number#config-number).

*See also: [LD2420 24GHz mmWave Radar Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2420#configuration-variables)*

gate_still_sensitivity.docs:
Gate still threshold calibration sensitivity factor. Defaults to 0.5 with a range of 0-1, 0 = high and 1 = low. May contain any options from [Number](https://esphome.io/components/number#config-number).

*See also: [LD2420 24GHz mmWave Radar Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2420#configuration-variables)*

max_gate_distance.docs:
Maximum gate for movement detection. Value from 1 to 15. Each gate detects movement and still energy at 70 cm increments. At the maximum value, the sensor's range equates to approximately 12 meters; however, accuracy at this range may be diminished. The recommended maximum value is 12 which results in approximately 9 meters. **Required** when `presence_timeout` and `min_gate_distance` are specified. May contain any options from [Number](https://esphome.io/components/number#config-number).

*See also: [LD2420 24GHz mmWave Radar Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2420#configuration-variables)*

min_gate_distance.docs:
Minimum distance for move or still energy detection. Value between 0 and `max_gate_distance` - 1. Each increment equals 70 cm. Defaults to 1. **Required** when `presence_timeout` and `max_gate_distance` is specified. May contain any options from [Number](https://esphome.io/components/number#config-number).

*See also: [LD2420 24GHz mmWave Radar Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2420#configuration-variables)*

presence_timeout.docs:
The time in seconds during which the occupied state (presence) will persist after presence is no longer detected. Any energy detection within the time window restarts the countdown from this value. Defaults to 120s. **Required** when `min_gate_distance` and `max_gate_distance` is specified. May contain any options from [Number](https://esphome.io/components/number#config-number).

*See also: [LD2420 24GHz mmWave Radar Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2420#configuration-variables)*

operating_mode.docs:
Provisions the operating mode select component. May contain any options from [Select](https://esphome.io/components/select#config-select).

*See also: [LD2420 24GHz mmWave Radar Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2420#configuration-variables)*

moving_distance.docs:
Distance between the sensor and the detected moving target. May contain any options from [Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor).

*See also: [LD2420 24GHz mmWave Radar Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2420#configuration-variables)*

fw_version.docs:
Allows you to retrieve the [Ld2420](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2420/) firmware version. May contain any options from [Text Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/text_sensor#config-text_sensor).

*See also: [LD2420 24GHz mmWave Radar Sensor](https://esphome.io/components/sensor/ld2420#configuration-variables)*
